card.name: Words before blue-collar or class terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words and verbs in social and economic commentary about workers, unions, jobs, wages and poverty, where 'blue' (as in blue-collar) could plausibly come next.

modes.label: Linking word in social statistics
modes.description: A preposition such as to or by inside a statistic about demographic groups.
modes.example: Nearly 40 percent of American babies are born<< to>> unwed mothers.

modes.label: Words in labor and jobs talk
modes.description: A linking word or verb in text about unions, wages and jobs.
modes.example: credited with saving thousands<< of>> union jobs.

card.writes: It pushes the word blue (as in blue-collar) as a likely next word.
card.plain: It fires in talk about workers, unions and wages, where the word blue, as in blue-collar, might come next.
